author: NASS
description:
Travel back in time to the Bronx, New York, in the 1930s, and discover daily life in one of the most iconic boroughs of the United States during the Great Depression. These exceptional archival images show bustling sidewalks, crowded apartment blocks, street vendors, children playing, and families working hard to get through one of the most difficult periods in American history.

If you enjoy our restored archival footage, please “like,” leave a comment, and subscribe to support our future projects.

📽️ Technologies & Techniques Used:
• Advanced video restoration
• New semantic colorization only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
• Manually colorized keyframes (to establish accurate ambiance and color consistency (not historically accurate)
• Advanced frame reconstruction to 4K
• Manual color corrections 
• Classical restoration workflows (AviSynth ) combined with modern tools for (60fps, stabilization, denoise, cleaning, and deblurring )
• Sound design created for immersive
title: The Bronx, New York 1930s, Life During the Great Depression | Advanced Colorization & 4K Restoration
